title: Identification of section comparisons on an etale upper tail
statement: Let I be a preorder, R a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], B : I opposite -> R.Etale a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and c any cone of its underlying scheme diagram. Let p : c.pt -> R and assume each cone leg followed by its stage structure map is p. Let H be a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], i0 an index, and nu a natural transformation to the sections of p inverse image H at the terminal etale object whose components are the inverse-image unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] followed by restriction along the diagonal pullback lift [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put D equal to the underlying scheme diagram, G equal to the inverse image of H along the structure map at i0, and W0 equal to the terminal etale object over D(i0). For every j in Over(i0 opposite), there exist isomorphisms a_j from H(B_j) to the sections of D(j.hom) inverse image G on the base change of W0, and an isomorphism l from the nu vertex to the sections of the cone-leg-at-i0 inverse image G on the limit-base-change object. For every arrow f : k -> j over i0, H(B(f) opposite) followed by a_k equals a_j followed by the canonical transition section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. Moreover nu_j followed by l equals a_j followed by the canonical cone section comparison. No directedness, qcqs, affine-transition, or limit hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For each upper-tail object j, the over-map B.map(j.hom) gives D(j.hom) followed by the stage-i0 structure map equal to the stage-j structure map. Define a_j as terminal restriction for B_j followed by terminal transport for this triangle. Define l as terminal transport for the cone leg at i0, using h(i0). Both are explicit isomorphisms constructed from the already proved composition and restriction isomorphisms.

Apply terminal transition compatibility to U=B_j,V=B_k,W=B_i0 and f=B.map(f.left),q=B.map(j.hom),r=B.map(k.hom). Functoriality of D and f.w supply the underlying triangle equality. These underlying maps are definitionally the maps used in the target.

Rewrite nu at j using hnu. Apply terminal cone compatibility to U=B_j,W=B_i0,q=B.map(j.hom),p=p,t=c_j,t0=c_i0. Cone naturality supplies t followed by q.left equal to t0 and h supplies both structure-map equalities. This yields the second compatibility equation, and the existential witnesses with the conjunction finish the proof.

proof_origin.note: Explicit isomorphism construction and diagram-free cone reduction. Transition compatibility is proved from cone compatibility and a proved restriction-unit/projection calculation. The only new sorry is terminal cone compatibility; the original existential theorem is fully proved from it.
